lines.text: The LORD of Hosts said that if the people return to Him, He will forgive them.

problems.problem: Its true detail "He will return to them" isn't in Zechariah 1:3 word for word.
Its wrong detail "He will bless them" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "He will return to them" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
